title: Choosing pictures, captions as you scroll, and every board’s stickers free
notes: Pictures open full screen and you scroll down through them — to look, or to write a caption under each one.
Adding to an album ends on the first new picture with the caption waiting, so nothing goes in unnamed.
In an album you can now choose pictures: select all or a few, then caption, move to another album, take out, or delete.
Love, Details and the calendar are proper pages instead of half-height panels, and the calendar fits the screen at last.
Every mood board’s stickers and graphics are free — they change when you change the board.
Help takes a real message, keeps it with a reference, and finishes your sentence when it is sure — press Tab.
